post.title: Resume tools want a paywall. Tailor wants a browser tab.
post.caption: One fresh grudge: every online tool for tailoring a resume sat behind a paywall or a sign-up, so someone built a free one that keeps your resume on your own device.

segments.gripe: Resume tools hide behind a paywall or a sign-up.
segments.quote: I couldn't find a simple to use online tool that wasn't blocked behind a paywall or sign up, so I made one.
